usedFor: Managers use SimpleKPI to record numbers with “Add KPI Data Entry” and fix them with “Update KPI Data Entry”.

bestTemplate.name: “Add KPI Data Entry” in SimpleKPI
bestTemplate.why: It adds a KPI entry for a date, so numbers arrive without typing.

watchOut: “Add KPI Data Entry” is for one date, so run it on a schedule that matches how often you measure.
